name: Strides Pharma Scien
about: Strides Pharma Science Ltd. is a leading pharmaceutical company that specializes in developing, manufacturing, and marketing generic medicines across multiple therapeutic areas. The company’s portfolio includes niche segments such as anti-retrovirals, oncology, central nervous system, and gastrointestinal treatments. With state-of-the-art manufacturing facilities in India, the US, and Europe, Strides Pharma adheres to stringent quality standards and regulatory compliance, supplying high-quality products to over 100 countries. The company emphasizes research-driven innovation, focusing on developing complex generics and differentiated formulations. Strides Pharma’s commitment to quality, affordability, and expanding access to essential medicines positions it as a key player in the global pharmaceutical landscape.
